recentItems.title: A new WORLD RECORD! 🥇🇨🇳 | 100m Freestyle Final | Paris 2024
recentItems.description:
📺 Re-live #Paris2024! ➡️ https://oly.ch/3REmN8s

Pan Zhanle has delivered a new 100m freestyle world record of 46.40, the first swimming world record of Paris 2024. The People’s Republic of China’s Pan had it in his sights from his magnificent start, leading the field, and finished a whole second ahead of Australia’s Kyle Chalmers, who took silver with a time of 47.48, followed by Romania’s David Popovici in bronze-medal position with a time of 47.49. An incredible moment followed as the competitors looked up at the clock to see Pan’s time and began applauding.

recentItems.title: Nicolo Martinenghi Storms to Gold, Tie For Silver! 🥇🇮🇹 | 100m Breaststroke Final | Paris 2024
recentItems.description:
📺 Re-live #Paris2024! ➡️ https://oly.ch/3REmN8s

Nicolo Martinenghi of Italy swam the race of his life to claim the men's 100m breaststroke title in 59.03 seconds at Paris 2024. All the talk before the race may have been about a historic 'three-peat' for Team GB's Adam Peaty but the two-time Olympic swimming champion was beaten to the wall by the rapid Italian, finishing in joint-second place in 59.05 as he shared the silver medal with the USA's Nic Fink.

recentItems.title: Team Azerbaijan's Magnificent Hoop Routine 🇦🇿🤸‍♀️ | Paris 2024
recentItems.description:
📺 Re-live #Paris2024! ➡️ https://oly.ch/3REmN8s

Team Azerbaijan qualified eighth and finished a strong fifth in the rhythmic gymnastics group all-around at Paris 2024. In the push for medals, their hoop routine to "La Terre vue du ciel" by Armand Amar was a performance you certainly couldn't miss.
